column1: # Walk area (kind 8) and the scene-setup object (kind 1) (28 Oct 2026)

column4: kind 8, 0xb4 bytes, vtable 0042bd60 (only slot 13 overridden), extends MidBase; starts the single-frame animation whose frame record holds the vertex list. Rename of inferred_Obj_Kind08_Ctor

vtable slot 13: runs each time Jim reaches a vertex. Steps the vertex index +0xa0 one towards the destination index +0xa4 and sends Jim to that vertex (Jim slot 32, target = this); when the indices are equal first sends Jim to the real destination (+0xa8,+0xac) with the original target (+0xb0)

(x, y, target) finds the polyline vertex nearest the destination (+0xa4) and the vertex nearest Jim (+0xa0), stores the destination (+0xa8,+0xac) and target (+0xb0), then sends Jim to his nearest vertex; always returns true when the polyline has vertices. No search algorithm: movement is along the vertex list

(x, y) perspective scale 0x100 = 1.0: finds the polyline edges spanning x, interpolates their y and per-vertex scale, then interpolates the scale vertically between the edge above and the edge below the point; 0x100 when no edge pair brackets the point

vtable slot 0 of kind 1 (run by Object_AttachToLevel): resolves the walk area object by the name at +0x6c in the level's object list (+0x78), sets the camera bounds to the first frame's rectangle and moves the camera to the object's position
slot 4 of kind 13: same pending-click dispatch as Interactive_Update, with an extra item-use path when no verb handler applies (calls the hovered object's slot 27)
(level, room, x, y) on the player: leaves the old level (removes from its lists and the main list), joins the new level, sets camera and position, inserts into the main list at priority 0x14

kind 6/other exit-style handler: when Jim is idle, resets display queues, looks up the destination level in the level table 00442130 by index (+0xa0) and name key (+0xa4,+0xa8), and moves Jim there with Jim_EnterLevel
